questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville gerne på udveksling til et engelsktalende land. Udover det lød Irland som et hyggeligt land med en fed pubkultur.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var relativt nemt, men man skal være forberedt på, at du først får styr på det hele efter du er kommet til Cork. Du vælger først endelig fag osv., når du er ankommet derhenne.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Det internationale kontor derhenne var meget hjælpsomme og jeg havde ingen problemer med at få godkendt flere fag og andet praktisk.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Det var relativt svært og utrolig dyrt for student accommodation helt generelt. Jeg boede i Brookfield Village, som lå ca 10 minutters gang fra campus. Det var klart et af de billigste steder at bo, og lå godt. Værelserne var gamle og det var ikke et mega prangende sted at bo, men jeg ville klart anbefale det i forhold til mange andre studieboliger, hvor man nærmest betaler det dobbelte.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Cork er ikke en så stor by, at det gør en kæmpe forskel at bo på off campus accommodation. Mange af UCC's egne campusboliger lå de samme steder som off campus boligerne.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Det var meget ligetil. Man skal dog være opmærksom på talkoderne på de forskellige kurser, da de angiver om det er bachelor eller kandidatfag.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Det internationale kontor var meget hjælpsomme og svarede hurtigt på mails osv.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle de timer, som jeg ønskede.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Man kan sagtens ændre fag og ønske nye fag efter man er startet. Men jeg synes, at kontoret på UCC var gode til at gøre op opmærksom på dette.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Jeg synes ikke det faglige var meget udfordrende på UCC. Jeg var på min bachelor og tog også fag på kandidatniveau, hvilket ikke var noget problem.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Det var meget anderledes end på KU. På nogen af holdene var man kun 8-10 elever og det var meget mere samtalebaseret.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
International Child Justice
Penology 
Legal Research and Writing.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg synes Penology var et mega fedt fag, så det vil jeg klart anbefale.

questions.question: Insurance DKK *
Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Ingen.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Det er generelt meget billigere at købe ind, så det var noget billigere end i København. Offentligt transport er også meget billigt, så det er smart at anskaffe sig et "Leap Card".

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Mit råd er at melde sig til så meget som muligt. Der er så meget sport og andre forskellige societies, som var noget af det bedste på hele udvekslingsopholdet.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: UCC har virkelig fedt udvalg af forskellige aktiviteter, der var så meget forskelligt sport og ture, som alt sammen var gratis at gå til.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Bare at melde sig til så meget som overhovedet muligt. Det er gratis og helt uforpligtende.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Der er mange små hyggelige byer omkring Cork, som klart er et besøg værd. Jeg så både Rugby og Hurling også, hvilket var en rigtig sjov oplevelse.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt, der er ikke så stor kulturforskel.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Jeg synes ikke der var noget udfordrende at tilpasse sig.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Der er en meget laid back kultur I Irland, hvilket var rigtig fedt. Udover det er pubkulturen også klart noget af det bedste ved Irland.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Vær åben over for alle de forskellige arrangementer og aktiviteter, som UCC står for. Vær forberedt på, at der er Housing Crisis i hele Irland, så det kan være svært og dyrt at finde bolig i Cork. Cork er et virkelig fedt sted at tage på udveksling.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Nej

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Hele mit udvekslingsophold i Cork var en fantastisk oplevelse.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Ikke nogen

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
